Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 v_check_digit VARCHAR2(2);
begin
 --nullchk;
 --check_package_failure;
 --RP Task# 169 05032028
 if NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID), 0) NOT IN (7,13) and :ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_ID = 'M'
 then
 show_error('1190');
 --message('Unit Length mut be 7 or 13 Characters.');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 --Make sure user enter only Alpha Numeric only. Check A -> 65, Z -> 90, 0 -> 48, 9 -> 57
 if :ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_ID = 'M' then
 FOR i in 1..length(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID) LOOP 
 if ASCII(SUBSTR(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID, i, 1)) BETWEEN 65 and 90 OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID, i, 1)) BETWEEN 48 and 57
 then
 null; 
 else
 show_error('5193');
 --message('Unit mut be Alpha Numeric Characters only.');
 EXIT;
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 END LOOP;
 if NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID), 0) >= 13 then
 --Check digit should be populated for ISBT/for unit less than 13 digits -- 05082018
 validate_unit_chkdigit ( :ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID ,v_check_digit ) ;
 :ctrl_blk_2.chk_digit := v_check_digit;
 end if;
 end if;
 --Task# 169
 
if :ctrl_blk_2.test_id is not null then
begin
 select distinct 'x' 
 into :global.x
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and (test_id = :ctrl_blk_2.test_id
 or 'ALL' = :ctrl_blk_2.test_id);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 --show_error('1230');
 --RP 05082018
 show_error('0210');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
 select chapter_id
 into :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id := '';
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0172');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id := :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id;
 begin
 select max(coll_date)
 into :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id;
 -- there cannot be situation where the
 -- chapter_id is not there but the collection
 -- date is there
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id is null
 then
 message('Unit has not been checked in...No chapter ID');
 end if;
 end if;

end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve IS
 where_clause VARCHAR2(1000);
 where_clause1 VARCHAR2(200);
 where_clause2 VARCHAR2(200);
 where_clause3 VARCHAR2(200);
 where_clause4 VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN
 /* where_clause := ' unit_id = nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id, unit_id) and (coll_date between '||
 ' nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.from_coll_date, coll_date) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.to_coll_date, coll_date) or coll_date is null)'||
 ' and nvl(chapter_id ,''WAD'') = nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id, ''WAD'') '||
 ' and (test_id = nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.test_id, test_id ) or ''ALL'' = nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.test_id, test_id)) '; */
/* where_clause := ' unit_id = nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id, unit_id) and (coll_date between '||
 ' nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.from_coll_date, coll_date) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.to_coll_date, coll_date) or coll_date is null)'||
 ' and nvl(chapter_id,''X'') = decode(nvl(chapter_id,''X''),''X'', ''X'',:GLOBAL.chapter_id) '||
 ' and (test_id = nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.test_id, test_id ) or ''ALL'' = nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.test_id, test_id)) '; 
*/--MLT 614 
 where_clause := ' unit_id = nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id, unit_id) and (coll_date between '||
 ' nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.from_coll_date, coll_date) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.to_coll_date, coll_date) or coll_date is null)'||
 ' and nvl(test_chapter_id,''X'') = decode(nvl(test_chapter_id,''X''),''X'', ''X'',:GLOBAL.chapter_id) '||
 ' and (test_id = nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.test_id, test_id ) or ''ALL'' = nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.test_id, test_id)) '; 
 if :ctrl_blk_2.nts_flag is not null then
 where_clause1 := ' and result_status_1 != ''NT'' '; 
 where_clause := where_clause|| where_clause1;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_2.show_cancel is not null then
 where_clause2 := ' and cancel_flag = ''Y'' ';
 where_clause := where_clause|| where_clause2; 
 else
 where_clause := where_clause||' and cancel_flag is null ' ;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_2.reactive is not null then 
 where_clause3 := ' and result_status_1 in (select code from master_codes '||
 ' where code_type = ''REAC'') ' ; 
 where_clause := where_clause || where_clause3;
 end if; 
 go_block('unit_test_base');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 set_block_property('unit_test_base', default_where, where_clause);
 :system.message_level := '5';
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if :unit_test_base.unit_id is null then
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 show_error('2331');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
END;
